title: Higurashi WHEN THEY CRY: Massacre Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An 'answer' arc of the Higurashi horror-mystery, adapted from Ryukishi07's visual novel. Rika Furude, who remembers the repeated tragedies in the village of Hinamizawa, searches for a way to break the cycle before the Cotton Drifting festival (Yen Press blurb via MangaUpdates). When Satoko's uncle Teppei returns and abuses her, Keiichi, Shion and Rena protest daily at child services and then rally villagers and the heads of the powerful families, against grudges left by the Dam War (ANN review).
life_message: Trusting friends and acting together as a community can change what seemed to be fate.
